mapper.select: SELECT * FROM documents WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.id,c.document_id,c.version_id,c.batch_id,v.file_id,v.title,f.filename,v.file_type, v.product_version,v.revision,c.chunk_index,c.content,c.content_hash,c.heading,c.heading_path,c.location, c.page_start,c.page_end,c.line_start,c.line_end,c.char_start,c.char_end,c.char_count FROM chunks c JOIN document_versions v ON v.id=c.version_id JOIN source_files f ON f.id=v.file_id WHERE c.batch_id=#{batchId} AND c.chunk_index > #{after} ORDER BY c.chunk_index LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT r.batch_id FROM document_releases r JOIN documents d ON d.id=r.document_id WHERE d.deleted=FALSE AND (r.product_version=#{version} OR r.product_version='*')
